name: smart-bookstore-edge
description: Cloudflare Worker that serves the frontend and routes the API to the Go and AI containers

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm run generate && VITE_API_URL=same-origin npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.generate: npm --prefix frontend run generate && npm run generate:worker
scripts.generate:worker: rm -rf worker/src/gen && mkdir -p worker/src/gen && export PATH="$PATH:/tmp/protoc/bin" && (command -v protoc >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -sSL https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/releases/download/v33.4/protoc-33.4-linux-x86_64.zip -o /tmp/protoc.zip && unzip -q -o /tmp/protoc.zip -d /tmp/protoc)) && protoc --proto_path=backend/proto --es_out=worker/src/gen --es_opt=target=ts backend/proto/bookstore.proto
